name: Error Handling Adequacy
description: Evaluate whether functions have adequate error handling based on structural and semantic analysis.

options.label: Propagates Errors (Good)
options.explanation: Function properly propagates errors to caller using Result type.

options.label: Errors Recovered Internally
options.explanation: Function handles errors internally with fallback logic.

options.label: Errors Ignored (Warning)
options.explanation: Function silently ignores errors — potential data loss or undefined behavior.

options.label: Panics on Error (Critical)
options.explanation: Function panics instead of returning errors — caller has no recovery path.

options.label: Not a Function Declaration
options.explanation: Error handling evaluation only applies to function declarations.
